function.name: _app_permission_update
function.description: Update a custom application permission (AppPermissionDefine). Before calling, use _app_permission_list to get the real permission ID. updateFieldList declares fields to modify. If changing moduleId to a table module, pass the table key; the system stores the internal module ID.

id.description: AppPermissionDefine object ID to update, from _app_permission_list.

updateFieldList.description: Fields to update in this call. Only key, name, and remark are supported. Fields not listed here will not be changed.

key.description: Custom permission identifier. Takes effect only when updateFieldList contains key.

name.description: Permission display name. Takes effect only when updateFieldList contains name.

remark.description: Permission description. Takes effect only when updateFieldList contains remark.
